notes.title: 0.32 : Minor content update
notes.content:
Added 4 passives scrolls :

- [b]Vanir Mushroom[/b] : Hp Regen & Wisdom
- [b]Hamingja Trinket[/b] : Luck & Dodge
- [b]Thor Bindrune[/b] : Power & Armor
- [b]Tyr Bindrune[/b] : Speed & Range

Added a text to the new game UI : "Survive 20 waves in any realm !"
